notes: The ASV makes the rectum chokmah the English subject and reshith the predicate, so the construction-supplied copula joins reshith with its supplied the, and thing is the generic completing principal, which carries the lexeme (rules 20, 29, 31).

The italic therefore answers to no conjunction morpheme in its clause and is added under rule 14's closing sentences; it is not folded into the imperative or into the following waw, which the ASV has already rendered Yea.
Both marginal alternatives were read and set aside; the printed text governs (rule 38).
